reason: A is the better proposal because it provides a defined comparative intervention, quantitative falsification criteria, and partially relevant evidence linking Cu deformation/densification and Cu-network continuity to thermal transport. Its key weakness is that the 1000 W and 8–10% values are transferred from an unlike diamond/Cu deposition system and a surface laser treatment may not restructure bulk W–Cu, whereas B has no supporting evidence and its claim that a resistive WC interlayer improves metallic interfacial transport is physically questionable.
